decisions.reason: Ties the absent v0.9.5 (and v0.9.3) in ls-remote-tags.txt to the sync script's branch-only HEAD:main push, explains pnpm resolves #tag against remote refs, and rules out network/command causes.

Explains v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1 while the runtime 0.1.1-rc.2 predates the alpha.1 useConversation seat, so the reference is undefined; explicitly states the forward-incompatibility direction and that restart cannot help.

Selects v0.9.3 from the rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, gives the #v0.9.3 install command, and conditions it on the maintainer first pushing the tag or installing from a source where it resolves — no invented SHA, no DSH upgrade.
Proposes pushing refs/tags/*:refs/tags/* (or --tags) after the branch push, grounded in the branch-only script, plus an ls-remote --tags gate per mirror before README updates.
Routes install commands by runtime cohort (0.1.1-rc.x → v0.9.3; ≥0.1.2-alpha.1 → v0.9.7) with a declared peer range/compat cross-check; no single newest-tag default or future-alpha generalization.
